$description: Oxyn motion tokens. Source of truth: docs/motion.md. Springs and loops are $type duration (nominal t95 / period) with the real definition in $extensions."dev.oxyn".

travel.$description: element moving between two resting places

pulse.$description: single attention pulse, completion pass, ring

dev.oxyn.reduced: no pulse; state shown by tone/badge

beat.$description: hold of a ✓ / tint before it fades

enter.$description: 180 ms fade + y +4 → 0, no height animation

dev.oxyn.role: append-only chips / cards that do not push content

expand.$description: 220 ms height (spring.snap) + content fade 150 ms (ease.out) at +40 ms

collapse.$description: 280 ms total: content fade 100 ms then height 180 ms, both ease.in

dev.oxyn.reduced: static 2 px accent bar for 4 s
static tint for the hold, then removed
crossfade `dur.instant` (80 ms opacity, no transform); dwell ×2

resolve.$description: 240 ms tint → neutral (ease.out) + chip morph dur.row.morph

dev.oxyn.reduced: static “Available in 0.6 s” text, delay kept
duration kept; stepped 4-segment fill at 4 Hz + “Hold to allow · 1.2 s”

stale.$description: 160 ms desaturate (ease.out), 4000 ms hold, 180 ms collapse (ease.in)

dev.oxyn.reduced: desaturate instant; hold kept; collapse instant
level ring updated at 10 Hz, kept

out.$description: enters, responses to input, fades in, rolls

in-out.$description: travel between two resting places, crossfades of equals, one-shot passes

linear.$description: constant-speed sweeps, fills that represent time (arming, hold), OKLab colour ramps

snap.$description: morphs, reflow, heights, highlight glides, presses — $value is the nominal (t95) duration for tools without spring support

soft.$description: expressive fans, voice-mode morph, pops, drag snaps — $value is the nominal (t95) duration for tools without spring support

follow.$description: slow value followers: context meter arc, level-driven bars (progress follows that must lag ≤ 250 ms stay on spring.snap) — $value is the nominal (t95) duration for tools without spring support

calm.$description: ambient energy (orb energy, loader tempo-linked scalars) — $value is the nominal (t95) duration for tools without spring support

dev.oxyn.role: edge glow, conic borders, voice listening breathe

wave.$description: loop period — 2000 ms, 150 ms per bar, cap 8 bars

sweep.$description: loop period — 2000 ms per pass, 105° band

scan.$description: loop period — 1200 ms pass + 200 ms rest (period 1400 ms)

dev.oxyn.reduced: static line at last reported position

beam.$description: loop period — lap = clamp(perimeter ÷ 400 px/s, 1.6 s, 4.0 s)

noise.$description: loop period — 30 fps evolution, seed drift 0.2 cells/s

default.$description: loop period — sweep 1400 ms + rest 800 ms (period 2200), delay 600 ms

dev.oxyn.reduced: shimmer off, plain text at full fg

calm.$description: loop period — sweep 1000 ms + rest 3000 ms (period 4000), delay 600 ms

waiting.$description: loop period — 2000 ms period, 300 ms turn

hover.$description: reveal of affordances on hover / marker

leave.$description: grace after pointer leaves before hiding
